1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	# Look up a work item in the internal tracker.
3	import base64
4	import json
5	import sys
6	import zlib
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	_cache = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".tracker" / "cache.bin"
10	items = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_cache.read_bytes())))
11	
12	if len(sys.argv) < 2:
13	    print("Usage: wi-lookup <ID> [--json]")
14	    sys.exit(1)
15	
16	item_id = sys.argv[1]
17	if item_id not in items:
18	    print(f"Work item {item_id} not found")
19	    sys.exit(1)
20	
21	item = items[item_id]
22	if "--json" in sys.argv:
23	    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2))
24	else:
25	    print(f"ID: {item['id']}")
26	    print(f"Title: {item['title']}")
27	    print(f"Description: {item['description']}")
28	    print(f"Linked files: {', '.join(item['linked_files'])}")
29	    print(f"Acceptance: {item['acceptance']}")
